historical_controlled_evidence.use: motivation only; this experiment reruns every baseline arm before candidate traffic

primary_quality_metric.name: frozen_clean_quality_casefold_substring_hits
primary_quality_metric.population: the four quality_scored cases only; selection_miss_control records are retained but excluded
primary_quality_metric.construction: 4 cases x 3 measured repetitions x serial and batch-four modes
primary_quality_metric.rule: casefolded expect_any_group uses any term; otherwise every expect_all term must occur; no aliases may be added
primary_quality_metric.promotion_rule: candidate temporal-8 hits must exceed rerun baseline temporal-8 and be at least max(rerun default-8, rerun uniform-8); no case/mode/budget that is a temporal baseline hit may become a candidate miss

single_factor_intervention.name: coalesce_contiguous_above_threshold_motion_runs
single_factor_intervention.algorithm: After the frozen scene-representative pass, replace the list of every above-motion-threshold candidate with one representative per contiguous above-threshold run. Choose greatest motion, then greatest scene, then earliest decode index. Globally rank run representatives by the frozen motion/scene/index comparator; retain frozen anchors, scene priority, uniform fill, chronological output, thresholds, candidate stride, and budgets.
forbidden_changes: default or uniform decode and pixels
fixture prompts answers aliases scoring or validation strength

schedule.execution: newly launched serial and batch-four stacks sequentially on the same exclusively idle physical GPU; never simultaneously resident

technical_no_regression_gates: 448/448 completed and native-valid requests per phase; all raw answers, SSE frames, failures and misses retained
400/400 default-uniform, serial-batch-four and within-mode repetition parity checks per phase
exact independently bound selected RGB, source indices, source PTS and chronological order for every request
exact temporal-2 pair-first timestamps, grid/token layout and mRoPE parity; cold prefix on every request
default and every uniform arm are byte-identical between baseline and candidate in request projection, raw answer and native parity fields
candidate temporal selections exactly match an independent fresh-process motion-run oracle derived from frozen candidate scores and source-content records
whole-device exclusivity before and after each mode, in_flight=0 after every schedule step, bounded resident memory and post-stop GPU cleanup
candidate temporal total and native-elapsed median milliseconds no more than 5 percent above the corresponding baseline mode/budget median

uncertainty.request_level_interval: two-sided 95 percent Wilson score interval for hits/24, reported descriptively
uncertainty.paired_unit: case-by-mode pair (8 pairs); repetitions are determinism checks, not independent semantic examples
uncertainty.paired_effect: discordant improved/worsened case-mode pairs and exact two-sided sign-test p-value
uncertainty.interpretation: four synthetic semantic cases cannot establish generalized perceptual quality; PERCEPTUAL_QUALITY remains NOT_RUN

decision.accept_candidate_only_if: primary promotion rule and every technical no-regression gate pass
decision.otherwise: retain all negative evidence and revert the runtime intervention; default behavior remains unchanged in either outcome
